left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria
  -  Age > or = 18 years old
  -  Patients willing to participate and provide an informed consent
  -  Patients undergoing an elective surgical procedure that requires use of non-depolarizing NMBA agents administered intraoperatively

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria
  -  Patients with unilateral disorders, such as stroke, [OR]  carpal tunnel syndrome, [OR]  broken wrist  [AND] with nerve damage, Dupuytren contracture, [OR]  or any similar wrist injury

left.raw_text:
-  Patients with systemic neuromuscular diseases such as myasthenia gravis
  -  Patients with significant organ dysfunction that can significantly affect pharmacokinetics of neuromuscular blocking  [OR] and reversal agents, i

right.raw_text: , severe renal impairment  [OR] or end-stage liver disease
